```{r}
traits <- read.csv(here("Data", "cleaned", "BC_bird_traits.csv"))
traits$habitat_density[traits$habitat_density == "dense"] <- 1
traits$habitat_density[traits$habitat_density == "semiopen"] <- 2
traits$habitat_density[traits$habitat_density == "open"] <- 3
##
positive <- c("American Wigeon", "Green-winged Teal", "Mallard", "Northern Pintail", "Northern Shoveler", "Bufflehead", "Canvasback", "Barrow's Goldeneye", "Common Goldeneye", "Red-breasted Merganser", "Common Merganser","Ring-necked Duck", "Greater Scaup", "Lesser Scaup", "Surf Scoter", "White-winged Scoter", "Alder Flycatcher", "Canada Goose", "Swamp Sparrow", "Red-winged Blackbird", "Common Yellowthroat", "Western Bluebird", "Steller's Jay", "Hairy Woodpecker", "American Robin", "Northern Flicker", "Olive-sided Flycatcher", "Mountain Bluebird", "American Three-toed Woodpecker", "Black-backed Woodpecker", "Western Wood-Pewee", "Northern House Wren", "Lazuli Bunting", "Cassin's Finch", "Pine Siskin","Black-backed Woodpecker", "Lewis's Woodpecker", "Dark-eyed Junco", "Townsend's Solitaire", "Acorn Woodpecker", "Tree Swallow", "American Kestrel", "Northern Hawk Owl", "White-throated Sparrow", "Chipping Sparrow", "White-crowned Sparrow", "Brown Creeper", "Tennessee Warbler", "Chestnut-sided Warbler", "Brewer's Sparrow", "Rock Wren", "Hermit Thrush", "White-breasted Nuthatch", "American Crow", "American Goldfinch", "Baltimore Oriole", "Black-billed Magpie", "Brown-headed Cowbird", "Clay-colored Sparrow", "Eastern Kingbird", "Nelson's Sparrow", "Savannah Sparrow", "Song Sparrow", "Yellow-bellied Sapsucker", "Canada Jay", "Lincoln's Sparrow", "MacGillivray's Warbler", "Spotted Towhee", "Turkey Vulture", "Brewer's Blackbird", "Say's Phoebe", "Warbling Vireo", "Veery", "Song Sparrow", "Red-breasted Nuthatch", "Mountain Chickadee", "Redpoll", "Western Screech-Owl", "Northern Pygmy-Owl", "Mountain Quail", "Black-capped Chickadee", "Downy Woodpecker", "Pacific Wren", "Connecticut Warbler", "Yellow-rumped Warbler", "Cedar Waxwing", "Eastern Bluebird")

missing_names <- negative[!(negative %in% traits$common_name)] #do all these names appear in the BC list?

null <- c("Mallard", "Ring-necked Duck", "Common Loon", "Mourning Dove", "Common Nighthawk", "Cassin's Finch","Pine Siskin", "Chipping Sparrow", "Dark-eyed Junco", "American Robin", "Townsend's Solitaire", "Hammond's Flycatcher", "Clark's Nutcracker", "Red-naped Sapsucker", "Western Tanager", "White-breasted Nuthatch", "Evening Grosbeak", "Pygmy Nuthatch", "Yellow-rumped Warbler", "Williamson's Sapsucker", "Red Crossbill", "Ruby-crowned Kinglet", "Pacific Wren", "Brewer's Blackbird", "Mountain Chickadee", "Nashville Warbler", "Swainson's Thrush",  "House Finch", "Red Crossbill", "American Goldfinch", "American Kestrel")
missing_names <- null[!(null %in% traits$common_name)] #do all these names appear in the BC list?

traits$positive <- ifelse(traits$common_name %in% positive, 1, NA)
traits$negative <- ifelse(traits$common_name %in% negative, 1, NA)
traits$null <- ifelse(traits$common_name %in% null, 1, NA)


traits <- traits %>%
    mutate(habitat_density = as.numeric(habitat_density)) %>% 
    filter(!if_all(c(positive, negative, null), is.na)) %>% 
    mutate(across(c(positive, negative, null), ~replace_na(.x, 0)))



```

```{r}
trait.pca <- traits %>% select(common_name, where(is.numeric), -elevational_range,-positive, -negative, -null, -nest_tree_use)

pca_result <- prcomp(trait.pca[,-1], scale. = TRUE) #variables are already scaled
##
pca_result$rotation
pca_result$x

#autoplot(pca_result, data = climate, loadings=T,loadings.label=T, label = T)
biplot(pca_result)

pca_loadings <- as.data.frame(pca_result$rotation) %>% select(1:10)

summary(pca_result)
VE <- pca_result$sdev^2
PVE <- VE / sum(VE)
PVE <- round(PVE, 2)

pve_df <- data.frame(
  PC = 1:length(PVE),
  PVE = PVE
)

(scree <- ggplot(pve_df, aes(x = PC, y = PVE)) +
  geom_col() +
  xlab("Principal Component") +
  ylab("Proportion of Variance Explained") +
  ggtitle("Scree Plot") +
  ylim(0, 1) +
    theme_bw()+
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:length(PVE)))
ggsave(here("Figures", "PCA", "scree plot.png"), plot = scree, width = 8, height =8)


##
pca_df <- as.data.frame(pca_result$x) %>%
  bind_cols(traits %>% select(common_name, positive, negative, null))
pca_df <- pca_df %>%
  mutate(fire_response = case_when(
    positive == 1 & negative == 0 & null == 0 ~ "Positive",
    positive == 0 & negative == 1 & null == 0 ~ "Negative",
    positive == 0 & negative == 0 & null == 1 ~ "Neutral",
    positive == 1 & negative == 1 & null == 0 ~ "Positive & Negative",
    positive == 1 & null == 1 & negative == 0 ~ "Positive & Neutral",
    negative == 1 & null == 1 & positive == 0 ~ "Negative & Neutral",
    TRUE ~ "None"
  ))

loadings <- as.data.frame(pca_result$rotation)  # columns = PCs, rows = traits
loadings$trait <- rownames(loadings)

# Optional: scale arrows for visualization
arrow_multiplier <- 5  # adjust to make arrows visible
loadings <- loadings %>%
  mutate(PC1_arrow = PC1 * arrow_multiplier,
         PC2_arrow = PC2 * arrow_multiplier)


(f1 <- ggplot(pca_df, aes(PC1, PC2, color = fire_response)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, alpha = 0.9) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(
    title = "PCA of Bird Traits Colored by Fire Response",
    x = paste0("PC1 (", round(summary(pca_result)$importance[2,1]*100, 1), "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC2 (", round(summary(pca_result)$importance[2,2]*100, 1), "%)")
  ) +
   geom_segment(data = loadings,
               aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = PC1_arrow, yend = PC2_arrow),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.3, "cm")),
               color = "black") +
  geom_text(data = loadings,
            aes(x = PC1_arrow * 1.1, y = PC2_arrow * 1.1, label = trait),
            color = "black", size = 3, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Positive" = "blue",
    "Negative" = "red",
    "Neutral" = "grey",
    "Positive & Negative" = "#e7298a",
    "Positive & Neutral" = "#66a61e",
    "Negative & Neutral" = "#e6ab02"
  )))
ggsave(here("Figures", "PCA", "all responses.png"), plot = f1, width = 10, height =8)

#If the colors are scattered randomly:
##Positive/negative response is not strongly associated with the traits included in the PCA.
```

```{r}
arrow_multiplier <- 3
loadings <- loadings %>%
  mutate(PC1_arrow = PC1 * arrow_multiplier,
         PC2_arrow = PC2 * arrow_multiplier)

# Plot
(f2 <- ggplot() +
  geom_segment(data = loadings,
               aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = PC1_arrow, yend = PC2_arrow),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.3, "cm")),
               color = "black") +
  geom_text(data = loadings,
            aes(x = PC1_arrow * 1.1, y = PC2_arrow * 1.1, label = trait),
            color = "black", size = 3) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(title = "PCA Trait Loadings", x = "PC1", y = "PC2"))
ggsave(here("Figures", "PCA", "pca loadings.png"), plot = f2, width = 10, height =8)

```

```{r}
pca_scores <- as.data.frame(pca_result$x)
pca_scores$species <- traits$common_name
pca_scores$positive <- traits$positive
pca_scores$negative <- traits$negative
pca_scores$null <- traits$null

# 3️⃣ ggplot biplot colored by positive
(f3 <- ggplot(pca_scores, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = factor(positive))) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("0" = "grey", "1" = "blue")) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(color = "Positive Response", x = "PC1", y = "PC2",
       title = "PCA of Bird Traits Colored by Positive Fire Response"))
(f4 <- ggplot(pca_scores, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = factor(negative))) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("0" = "grey", "1" = "red")) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(color = "Negative Response", x = "PC1", y = "PC2",
       title = "PCA of Bird Traits Colored by Negative Fire Response"))

(pos.neg <- f3/f4)
ggsave(here("Figures", "PCA", "pca by response.png"), plot = pos.neg, width = 8, height =10)


##
(f5 <- ggplot(pca_scores, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = factor(positive))) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("0" = "grey", "1" = "blue")) +
  theme_bw() +
  geom_text(aes(label = species), size = 3) +
  labs(color = "Positive Response", x = "PC1", y = "PC2",
       title = "PCA of Bird Traits Colored by Positive Fire Response"))
(f6 <- ggplot(pca_scores, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = factor(negative))) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("0" = "grey", "1" = "red")) +
    geom_text(aes(label = species), size = 3) +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(color = "Negative Response", x = "PC1", y = "PC2",
       title = "PCA of Bird Traits Colored by Negative Fire Response"))

(pos.neg.spp.names <- f5/f6)
ggsave(here("Figures", "PCA", "pca by response spp names.png"), plot = pos.neg.spp.names, width = 20, height =20, dpi = 300)
```
